newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tenaga 6-mth net seen around 500 mln rgt.
newsitem.headline: Tenaga 6-mth net seen around 500 mln rgt.

text.p: Malaysian power utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd should show a net profit of around 500 million ringgit for the six months to February 28, 1997, analysts said on Monday.

"We are expecting a net profit of around 503 million ringgit for the half year, with the pre-tax profit at 701 million ringgit," said Sharinaz Shafie, power analyst at ABN Amro Hoare Govett in Kuala Lumpur.
For the six months to February 29, 1996 Tenaga made a net profit of 370 million ringgit, and a pre-tax profit of 530 million ringgit.

Analysts said the depreciation of the Japanese yen against the Malaysian ringgit over the period, and the appreciation of the local currency against the U.S. dollar would contribute to the imporvement in profits.
Tenaga is expected to release its results for the half-year period at around 5.00 p.m. local time (9.00 a.m. GMT).
For the full year to August 31, 1997, analysts said they expect Tenaga's earnings to be boosted by a recent tariff hike to about 1.2 billion ringgit.
"The full year will depend on how people impute the new tariffs. We expect around 1.2 billion," said Adin Jarjis at Pesaka Jardine Fleming.
